brief: Compute the exact total cents for rows whose status is paid; ignore void and pending rows. Rows: [{"id":"a","status":"paid","cents":125},{"id":"b","status":"void","cents":990},{"id":"c","status":"paid","cents":275},{"id":"d","status":"pending","cents":700},{"id":"e","status":"paid","cents":-50},{"id":"f","status":"paid","cents":80}]. Each worker independently puts its arithmetic and selected IDs on a board entry evidence/<your-name>. Read the other worker evidence, challenge a concrete possible error, and agree one final proposal including the exact line TOTAL_CENTS=<integer>. The verifier must independently calculate with a local command and agree only if correct. Do not modify repository files. Keep the exchange concise and finish once verified.
hash_method: At launch, sha256 each dist/**/*.js; hash UTF-8 sorted path + NUL + file SHA256 + LF. External dependencies excluded. Entry hash alone is identical across arms; server hash differs.

method.bytes: UTF-8 bytes of returned text blocks joined by newline; excludes JSON transport envelope and non-text blocks
method.tokens: Provider-reported usage, separate from text bytes; missing fields are unknown, not zero
method.candidates: Observed patterns, not a finding that every matched call was unnecessary
method.coverage: Denominator is seats found in supplied artifacts, not a room roster. Sidecars supply usage without traces and supersede transcript usage.

reply_metrics.definition: Deduplicated persisted non-opening agent chat/target pairs, public and quiet; membership at ask from ordered join/leave events. Strict reply is later target chat with exact replyTo or persisted @-back within <=window; one reply may credit multiple asks. Syntactic proxy, not task success. Activity counts any later non-opening target post. Unknown membership excluded from live denominator; pending includes early answered pairs.

limitations: One live run per arm, serial unrandomized order, changing conversation paths; no causal claim about total usage or call reduction.
Simple visible arithmetic oracle, not a hidden-fixture coding benchmark.
No steering behavior changed; stats reply rates included for completeness, not an improvement claim.
